title: Bubble up errors to the user when session/power actions aren't working
line: When logging out, shutting down, restarting, sleeping, locking or switching user fails, Plasma now shows a notification with the reason instead of silently doing nothing.
explanation: SessionManagement in libkworkspace (used by Kickoff, Kicker, the logout screen and the session shortcuts) sends every session action as a D-Bus call to the logout screen, plasma-shutdown, the screen locker, the display manager or logind, and never looked at the reply. When one of those calls failed (service missing or broken, logind or polkit refusing), the error was thrown away and the button just did nothing. The change checks each reply and, on error, sends a "Session Management" notification titled after the action ("Could not log out", "Could not shut down", "Could not sleep"…) with the D-Bus error message, keeping short-lived callers like the logout screen alive until the notification has been sent.

commits.message:
libkworkspace: notify the user when a session or power action fails

When a logout, shutdown, restart, sleep, lock or user switch failed,
the D-Bus error was dropped and clicking the button did nothing at
all. Now the error is shown in a notification named after the action.

BUG: 500867
